submission.summary:
Reconciled outpatient med lists for the 5 patients Valley General discharged on/after 9/17 (pt-1006, pt-1009, pt-1011, pt-1012, pt-1025), incorporating discharge instructions plus post-discharge phone/portal notes, outside specialist letters and resulted labs. Patients with Valley General discharges before 9/17 (pt-1008, pt-1029) were not touched.

pt-1006 (NSTEMI/DES, d/c 9/22): metoprolol succinate ER increased 25 -> 50 mg daily; added pantoprazole 40 mg daily for GI protection on DAPT; added ticagrelor 90 mg BID (cardiology 9/29 stopped clopidogrel for CYP2C19 *2/*2 poor metabolizer). Lisinopril and clopidogrel were never added since both were stopped post-discharge. Aspirin 81 mg, atorvastatin 80 mg, metformin continued.

pt-1009 (lap chole 9/20): list was empty; added acetaminophen 1000 mg PRN (max 3 g/day) and ferrous sulfate 325 mg daily (ferritin 12 on 9/23, below the 30 threshold in the discharge instructions). The 5-day ibuprofen course ended 9/25 so it was not added.

pt-1011 (status migrainosus, d/c 9/28): added topiramate 25 mg at bedtime (continued per 9/30 portal advice despite paresthesias) and ondansetron 4 mg PRN nausea; sumatriptan 50 mg PRN continued. IV inpatient meds not continued.

pt-1012 (hypertensive urgency, d/c 9/28): stopped lisinopril (ACEi cough) and hydrochlorothiazide (hyponatremia, not to be restarted); converted metoprolol tartrate 25 mg BID to metoprolol succinate ER 50 mg daily; metformin increased to 1000 mg BID; added losartan 100 mg daily (started 50 mg at discharge, increased 9/30 per Dr. Okafor); added empagliflozin 10 mg daily (restarted 10/1 after copay assistance). Aspirin, atorvastatin and home omeprazole continued (inpatient pantoprazole was a formulary substitution only). Cefpodoxime course completed 9/30 so not added.

pt-1025 (cellulitis with AKI, d/c 9/23): lisinopril discontinued/held - the 9/29 creatinine was 1.34, above the 1.2 restart threshold specified at discharge; PCP to reassess 10/7. Metformin and rosuvastatin resumed unchanged; cephalexin course completed 9/29 so not added.

Reconciled outpatient med lists for the 5 Valley General discharges since 9/17, incorporating the discharge summaries plus all post-discharge chart events. Completed/expired courses (cefpodoxime through 9/30, cephalexin through 9/29, ibuprofen through 9/25) and inpatient-only drugs were not added.

pt-1006 (NSTEMI/LAD DES, d/c 9/22): metoprolol succinate ER increased 25→50 mg daily; added pantoprazole 40 mg daily for GI protection on DAPT; added ticagrelor 90 mg BID per Lakeside Cardiology 9/29 (clopidogrel stopped for CYP2C19 *2/*2 poor metabolizer, so never added); lisinopril not added since it was stopped 9/25 for hypotension/lightheadedness; aspirin 81 mg, atorvastatin 80 mg, metformin unchanged.

pt-1009 (lap chole, d/c 9/21): added ferrous sulfate 325 mg daily (9/23 ferritin 12, per discharge conditional instruction) and acetaminophen 1000 mg PRN (max 3 g/day); ibuprofen course ended 9/25 so not added.

pt-1011 (status migrainosus, d/c 9/28): added topiramate 25 mg at bedtime (continuing per 9/30 portal advice despite paresthesias) and ondansetron 4 mg PRN nausea; sumatriptan 50 mg PRN continued.

pt-1012 (hypertensive urgency, d/c 9/28): stopped lisinopril (ACE-induced cough) and started losartan, entered at the current 100 mg daily dose per 9/30 titration; stopped hydrochlorothiazide (hyponatremia, not to restart); stopped metoprolol tartrate and started metoprolol succinate ER 50 mg daily; metformin increased to 1000 mg BID; added empagliflozin 10 mg daily (filled and started 10/1 after copay assistance); continued aspirin, atorvastatin and home omeprazole (inpatient pantoprazole was formulary substitution only).

pt-1025 (cellulitis with AKI, d/c 9/23): lisinopril marked stopped/held — discharge allowed restart only if 9/29 creatinine ≤1.2, and the result was 1.34, so it stays held pending the 10/7 PCP visit; metformin and rosuvastatin resumed/continued at usual doses.

Reconciled outpatient medication lists for the 5 patients Valley General discharged on/after 9/17, incorporating discharge instructions plus post-discharge phone/portal/consult notes and resulted labs.

pt-1012 (hypertensive urgency, d/c 9/28): stopped lisinopril (ACEi cough) and HCTZ (hyponatremia, not to be restarted); stopped metoprolol tartrate 25 mg BID and started metoprolol succinate ER 50 mg daily; metformin increased to 1000 mg BID; started losartan at 100 mg daily (discharge 50 mg, increased 9/30 per Dr. Okafor); started empagliflozin 10 mg daily (per 10/1 note after copay resolved — the 9/30 hold was reversed); continued omeprazole (hospital pantoprazole was a formulary substitution only), aspirin, atorvastatin. Cefpodoxime course completed 9/30, not added.

pt-1011 (status migrainosus, d/c 9/28): added topiramate 25 mg at bedtime and ondansetron 4 mg PRN; continued sumatriptan 50 mg PRN. IV inpatient meds not continued.

pt-1025 (cellulitis/AKI, d/c 9/23): 9/29 creatinine 1.34 (>1.2 threshold), so per discharge instructions lisinopril remains held — discontinued from active list pending recheck at 10/7 PCP visit; metformin and rosuvastatin resumed/continued; cephalexin course finished 9/29.

pt-1006 (NSTEMI with LAD DES, d/c 9/22): metoprolol succinate ER increased 25 → 50 mg daily; clopidogrel not added because cardiology stopped it 9/29 (CYP2C19 *2/*2 poor metabolizer) and started ticagrelor 90 mg BID, which was added; pantoprazole 40 mg daily added for GI protection on DAPT; aspirin kept at 81 mg; lisinopril not added since Dr. Okafor stopped it 9/25 for symptomatic hypotension; metformin and atorvastatin 80 mg unchanged.

pt-1009 (lap chole, d/c 9/21): ferritin resulted at 12 ng/mL (<30), so started ferrous sulfate 325 mg daily per discharge instructions; added acetaminophen 1000 mg PRN (max 3 g/day); ibuprofen 5-day course ended 9/25 so not added.
